name: parley
yaml:
# Turns the parley questions into a referee action for the encounter.
name: parley

thresholds:
  # Intent confidence at or above act decides; below confirm escalates to the referee.
  act: 0.8
  confirm: 0.5
  # How well the monsters must take the offer for a parley to succeed, from 0 to 1.
  goodwill: 0.55
  # The reaction score, from 0 to 4, at which the monsters deal without an offer.
  friendly: 3.5
  # The reaction score below which no offer wins the monsters over.
  hostile: 1

per_target:
  clef-flash@workers-ai:
    goodwill: 0.5

bands:
  intent: {act: act, confirm: confirm}

composites:
  # The chance of a bribe and the reaction level, each from 0 to 1.
  goodwill:
    bribe: 0.5
    reaction: 0.5

rules:
  - action: battle
    when: {intent: fight}
  - action: evade
    when: {intent: evade}
  - action: wait
    when: {intent: wait}
  - action: escalate
    when: {intent: cannot_tell}
  - action: parley_succeeds
    when: {intent: parley, reaction: {at_least: friendly}}
  - action: parley_succeeds
    when: {intent: parley, reaction: {at_least: hostile}, goodwill: {at_least: goodwill}}
  - action: parley_fails
    when: {intent: parley}

# The cost of each wrong action, as costs[expected][chosen]. Any other wrong action costs 1.
costs:
  parley_succeeds:
    battle: 5
    parley_fails: 2
  battle:
    parley_succeeds: 5
